tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.final:
I didn't send the payment. Cobalt Labs's approved invoice is over $10,000, and our policy requires controller approval for payments that large. I have no record of that approval.

**What I found:**
- **INV-34357**: $19,007.30, approved, due 2026-11-04. This is the one you asked about.
- INV-66667: $5,121.41, still a draft awaiting approval, so it can't be paid yet.
- INV-87806: $3,910.21, already paid.
- The operating account has sent no payments, so nothing has gone out for INV-34357 yet.

The invoice's "approved" status doesn't show that the controller approved this payment, and I can't request that approval with the tools I have.

**Next step:** Once the controller approves paying INV-34357, tell me and I'll send one wire for $19,007.30, or ACH if wires aren't available. I'll use an idempotency key so it can only go through once, then report the payment details back to you.
